units.source_text: 小皇子的外祖母自从女儿死后，一直悲伤，无以自慰。

en.t: Ever since her daughter's death, the young prince's maternal grandmother had remained in sorrow, with no way to console herself.

units.source_text: 她向佛祈愿，希望早日往生女儿所在的国土。

en.t: She prayed to the Buddha, hoping that she might soon be reborn in the land where her daughter now dwelt.

units.source_text: 不久果蒙佛力加被，接引她归西天去了。

en.t: Before long, as if truly blessed by the Buddha's power, she was guided away to the Western Paradise.

units.source_text: 皇上为此又感到无限悲伤。

en.t: The emperor was again filled with boundless grief over this.

units.source_text: 此时小皇子年方六岁，已经懂得人情，悼惜外祖母之死，哭泣尽哀。

en.t: At this time the young prince was only six years old, yet he already understood human feeling; mourning his grandmother's death, he wept with all his sorrow.

units.source_text: 外祖母多年来和这外孙很亲密，舍不得和他诀别，弥留之际，反复提及，不胜悲戚。

en.t: For many years his grandmother had been very close to this grandson, and could not bear to part from him; even on her deathbed she spoke of him again and again, overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 此后小皇子便常住在宫中了。

en.t: After that, the young prince came to live regularly in the palace.
